title: Explainable AI is Responsible AI: How Explainability Creates Trustworthy and Socially Responsible Artificial Intelligence
reasoning: The paper is a scoping review focused on 'Responsible AI', which it defines as the field of applying ethics to the development and utilization of AI. It evaluates ethical pillars such as fairness, accountability, and transparency, and uses case studies (including Generative AI) to show how explainability supports these ethical frameworks.
